name: Paris
tagline: Croissant for breakfast, cigarette smoke for atmosphere.
journal:
I had a list. I tossed the list. Paris is better when you are slightly late for everything you didn't plan.

Mornings at a café in the 11th, watching old men argue about something I couldn't follow. Afternoons in the Marais, getting lost on purpose. Evenings on a bridge.

The Eiffel Tower was smaller than I expected and twice as good.

photos.alt: A Parisian café in the morning
View from a Seine bridge at dusk
